health.waiver: No provider telemetry snapshot is published, so every producer-side stage -- provider lateness, transformation, compositor, publication, and the origin half of delivery -- is observed as unavailable on every run. Their alerts are still raised and reported under waivedAlerts, but they do not fail a run that no evidence could ever pass. What stays enforced is what the monitor observes for itself: the deployed client reaching current production data, and the delivered bundle advancing within maximumLatestManifestAgeMinutes. Remove a stage from waivedStages once THEMARBLE_HEALTH_SNAPSHOT_URL publishes evidence for it.

acceptance.cryosphereWaiver: Snow and sea ice are published daily from the US National Ice Center IMS analysis served by NSIDC (G02156), which covers the Northern Hemisphere only. The Southern Hemisphere is recorded as unobserved rather than filled, so Antarctic sea ice is absent. Set requireCryosphere true once a global analysis is configured: GMASI needs an operations-supplied endpoint, AMSR2 and VIIRS an Earthdata token.
